properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Azure Document Intelligence: Managed Identity Required
properties.description: Audits Azure Document Intelligence (Form Recognizer) accounts that do not have a managed identity configured. FedRAMP High requires identification and authentication (IA-2). Managed Identity eliminates API key management and enables Entra ID authentication with RBAC, conditional access policies, and centralized audit logging.

metadata.description: Audit: Report Document Intelligence accounts without managed identity. Deny: Block deployment. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
